visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene starts with a POV shot from a bicycle handlebar. A smartphone mounted on the center displays the time '3:23'. The rider’s left hand is visible on the grip. A woman in black cycling gear and a helmet rides ahead on a paved path beside a green riverbank with tall grass. Urban residential buildings are visible on the horizon under an overcast sky. (2) The camera angle shifts to a side-view selfie perspective of a man. He wears a grey t-shirt, a dark green cycling helmet, and large iridescent reflective glasses. He has white wireless earbuds in both ears. He is pedaling alongside a path lined with tall reeds. (3) A screen recording of a fitness tracking application displays a map of Taipei City. The screen shows data for a 'Wenshan District Electric Off-road Cycling' activity. Statistics like 14.62 km, 58:35 duration, and 15.0 km/h average speed are visible. (4) A montage of still photos begins. The first photo shows the man and the woman in black posing on the path; the woman raises one arm in a peace sign. The second photo features the man sitting on his green mountain bike in a grassy park area. The third photo is a close-up of a white and gold smartwatch showing a heart rate and distance. The final photo shows the woman posing with her bike against a background of a large building on a hill.
